notes.title: Boss Rush: Mythology Update 1.04
notes.notes:
Update 1.04:
- The cost of weapons and items has been reduced.
- Reduced the number of stars for unlocking new bosses.
- Added easy difficulty level.
- Added support for Dualshock 4. Along with the change of icons, the type of control also changes.
